title: Record why the checks missed it
statement: With every confirmed defect, record why the existing checks missed it, so the gap in the checks is fixed along with the item.
detail: A lesson audit's workflow requires every issue to record, besides its symptom, reproduction, expected behaviour, cause and cause confidence, why earlier checks missed it, and each finding record carries a priorTestGap field for it. Two of its findings show what the field catches: a test suite that tested one grade's isolated branch but expressly allowed the unisolated branch and never exercised the other grade's caller, and a question whose tests checked only the key's index and so never tested a competing interpretation. Naming the gap points the repair at the checks as well as at the item.

evidence.quote: Every issue records its visible symptom, minimal reproduction, expected behavior and source, affected pages, code mechanism, cause confidence, and why earlier checks missed it.
The earlier suite tested the isolated branch but expressly allowed the unisolated branch; it never exercised the Grade 3 caller.
Cause: the question omitted the comparison group; answer-index testing alone never tests competing interpretations.
